name: Is framing a small addition better than doing a full remodel?

mainEntity.name: Is framing a small addition better than doing a full remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Framing is the right comparison point when you’re deciding between a small bump-out, a larger addition, or a remodel that changes walls inside the house. A smaller addition may be more practical if you want extra space without the cost and complexity of a major expansion.
acceptedAnswer.description: If you mainly need more space, a small addition may be simpler than a major remodel. The better choice depends on how much structure you want to change and your budget.
